description: Observed METAR data for five US airports from NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center, signed with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-87. Each object includes its position in a hash-chained source registry. The free verifier checks signatures and expiry, not the chain. Observed data, not a flight decision, not certified. Synthora is not affiliated with NOAA or NWS and they do not endorse this service. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]
